author: Verity I
title: Hybrid 32-start SLSQP + LP finalize with safe persistence (slack check on micro-shrunk radii); return loader v4
abstract: Runs a two-stage offline search: 32-start SLSQP (breadth) followed by a 500-iter SLSQP refinement (depth). Each candidate is re-finalized with exact LP. We persist a new artifact only if Δ∑r > 1e−8 and the min slack computed on micro-shrunk radii (×(1−1e−12)) is ≥ 1e−10. Regardless of search outcome, the returned tuple uses the immutable loader v4 policy: centers unchanged from artifact, radii ×(1−1e−12).
